name: Complementary Color Finder
summary: Find the complementary color for any hex or RGB — plus split-complementary, analogous, and triadic harmonies.
description: Pick or paste a base color to get its complementary (hue + 180°) and related harmony swatches: split-complementary, analogous, and triadic. Copy hex values instantly. Everything runs locally.

faqs.question: How is complementary calculated?
faqs.answer: The hue is rotated 180° in HSL while keeping saturation and lightness the same.

faqs.question: What else is shown?
faqs.answer: Split-complementary (±150/210°), analogous (±30°), and triadic (+120/+240°) swatches for quick palette ideas.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Color math runs entirely in your browser.
